decisions.reason: Two years in, the handle family shows no negative signal and costs little to hold within the modular lever range, so the option stays open while its value resolves.
The mitred family shares production and finishing with the core range, so holding it is cheap, and the evidence is still too thin to justify abandoning it.
This single multifunctional handle fits the firm's accessibility direction, and with no adverse result yet the low holding cost justifies waiting for more evidence.
The lever line has not revealed weak value, and keeping it costs little, so waiting remains preferable to withdrawal.
The award-winning collection with its own dedicated page has shown positive early results that support further commitment rather than abandonment.
